outcome: Risk factors for esotropia and exotropia
cohort: 123 infants less than 1 year of age diagnosed with infantile-onset strabismus at a tertiary eye care center from August 2018 to December 2019
finding: This study found a 2.6% hospital prevalence of infantile strabismus, with esotropia twice as common as exotropia, and identified specific risk factors for each condition, suggesting early surgical correction for potential binocular vision improvement.
mod_finding: Delivery by cesarean section was associated with increased odds of developing exotropia.
